1: NAN. Then I'll send mother! [ Runs away ]. NIKÍTA [ rises ] How can I go? How can I take the holy icón in my hands? How am I to look her in the face! [ Lies down again ] Oh, if there were a hole in the ground, I'd jump in! No one should see me, and I should see no one! [ Rises again ] No, I shan't go … May they all go to the devil, I shan't go! [ Takes the rope and makes a noose, and tries it on his neck ] That's the way!
